## Review
- Correct: An accepted pet `pointerdown` first succeeds in the shared `WindowDragController.begin`, then invokes `onBegin`, which starts the native `set_pet_dragging(..., true)` lease before pointer capture is taken ([windows/src/pet-pointer-drag.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet-pointer-drag.ts:49), [windows/src/pet-window.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet-window.ts:341)). The native loop keeps an active-drag window interactive ([windows/src-tauri/src/lib.rs](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src-tauri/src/lib.rs:745)).
- Correct: Threshold drag startup waits for acquisition: `startDrag` awaits `petInteractionLease.wait()` before `beginManualDrag` ([windows/src/pet-window.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet-window.ts:360)). Non-drag click and cancellation both call `finishCapture`; these paths are covered by [windows/src/pet-pointer-drag.test.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet-pointer-drag.test.ts:87).
- Correct: Direct late-release protection in `PetInteractionLease` is valid for the tested acquisition-pending sequence: `finish` compares the captured lease object with `this.active` after awaiting activation ([windows/src/pet-interaction-lease.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet-interaction-lease.ts:35)). The deferred activation test covers this exact sequence ([windows/src/pet-interaction-lease.test.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet-interaction-lease.test.ts:32)).
- Blocker: The complete drag lifecycle is not generation-bound, so a prior drag can release a newer accepted gesture. `WindowDragController.finish` clears its active drag immediately and returns a deferred completion ([windows/src/window-drag.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/window-drag.ts:75)); a new pointerdown may therefore begin a new lease before the old completion runs. When the old completion eventually calls `finishDrag` ([windows/src/window-drag.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/window-drag.ts:147)), [windows/src/pet-window.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet-window.ts:367) calls `finishPetInteractionLease()` without the original lease token. `PetInteractionLease.finish()` then captures whatever lease is currently active ([windows/src/pet-interaction-lease.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet-interaction-lease.ts:35)), which is the newer gesture, and deactivates it. This violates the required overlapping-lifecycle guarantee and can make the new drag click-through before its pointer capture ends. Existing coverage only tests a direct `finish()` before a later `begin()`, not a delayed `WindowDragController` completion followed by a newer `pointerdown` ([windows/src/pet-interaction-lease.test.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet-interaction-lease.test.ts:32), [windows/src/pet-window-drag.test.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet-window-drag.test.ts:9)).
- Note: The OS-level reduced-motion branch stops page and modal animations, but the in-app `body.reduce-motion` branch does not. Page and modal animations remain defined at [windows/src/styles.css](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/styles.css:352) and [windows/src/styles.css](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/styles.css:944), while only the `@media (prefers-reduced-motion)` branch disables them ([windows/src/styles.css](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/styles.css:1688)). The newly added aura is correctly disabled in both branches ([windows/src/styles.css](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/styles.css:1690)).
- Note: Added dictionary keys used by Settings, including `Create`, `Icon`, `Stats`, and `Level up`, exist for `vi`, `zh`, and `zh-TW`; the focused test verifies those keys ([windows/src/i18n.test.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/i18n.test.ts:15)). However, the popover neither receives `lang-changed` nor re-applies its strings when reopened ([windows/src/popover.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/popover.ts:100)); it also requests the visible `Your little companion` key, which is absent from [windows/src/i18n.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/i18n.ts:8).
